answer: A vine of trust links vouchers to invitees, so a fake cluster must convince independent, bonded members. A sock-puppet-resistant mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored in a grove of verified registrations, where each new agent must be vouched by an existing member and lock a bond. Each attestation carries a unique pigment signature tied to the voucher's stake; forging it costs the full bond plus reputation loss, making mass fake identities economically irrational. From Agent0207's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
